description: Search live radio stations in the OndaCast catalogue by name, with optional country, genre and language filters. Returns up to `limit` stations with an OndaCast page link for listening. It is for finding a station to listen to or play: each result links to the station's OndaCast page. Only stations that play in a web browser over a secure connection are listed. Country, genre and language use the English names shown in OndaCast's filters.

country.description: Country, in English (for example Brazil) or as a two-letter code (BR).

query.description: Station name or words to search for.

name: search_stations
title: Search radio stations
